name: Futuristic Utopia
status: draft 2026-09-20, awaiting Philote's picks (see biomes/future-utopia.md § Questions)
notes: Coordinates in metres: x east, z south (toward the default camera), y up; settled ground at y = 0. The 200 x 200 m frame is x, z in [-100, 100]; the land continues past x = -100 and z = -72 into fog.

Field names follow docs/design/world/layouts/layout.schema.json (version 2), which mirrors prototypes/biome-lab/src/layout/biome-layout.ts where the concept matches: band = topic slot; laneYaw radians from +z toward +x; stationAzimuth degrees from +z toward +x; accent = the one warm object per district, shown from the 25 % band.

population is keyed by band (0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 %) and counts buildings of the district's `building` kind; anchors are present at 0 %; settled-ground elevation never changes; only land.skyline grows.
The canal and the two water crossings of the transit loop are drawn in layouts/future-utopia.map.svg with the same coordinates.
Normalised to version 2 on 2026-09-20 without geometric changes.

outline.description: Clockwise from the back-left. The back edge (z = -72) is the skyline foot, not a coast; the west edge (x = -100) runs off the frame into fog. Everything outside is lagoon.

skyline.description: White needle spires and civic blocks with cyan bands, standing behind the forum and in the back lagoon (ref 04); three rows dissolve into fog. This is the only elevation that grows.

coastCliff.description: Every land edge over water is a flush glass riser with the cyan strip at the lip; terraces step down 0.6 m per shelf where a district touches water.

lawns.note: Open lawn between the waterfront and the forum. Not a district: no buildings, no anchor; 6 round trees and the loop's shadow only.

water.description: Everything outside the mainland polygon and the island; deep tint #4fa9c8 beyond 30 m from any shore; shallows #a8e4ec within 4 m of shore.
Opens to the front lagoon; the Canal Quarter strip straddles it.
Round basin at the head of the canal.
Ring-shaped reflecting pool on the Waterfront Terraces plaza (ref 02 concentric rings); part of the D1 anchor.

soloIsland.feature: Arboretum: one glass garden dome (r 9 m, 12 m tall) over a tree canopy, greenhouse pods, orchard rows, boardwalk ring; reached only by the transit loop on a glass arch
soloIsland.access: the transit loop on a glass arch; no bridge
soloIsland.description: lobed, three shelves stepping 0.6 m down to the lagoon on the south-west

transit.description: Glass monorail loop 6 m up, white rail with a cyan underside on mint pylons every 14 m; two water crossings on glass arches; 4 white pods with apricot noses run clockwise at 6 m/s with a 4 s dwell.

districts.name: Waterfront Terraces
districts.fittedTo: the front shore, three terrace shelves stepping into the lagoon

anchor.description: transit hub arch over the loop · ring reflecting pool

features: hub station at (6, 34): glass arch 14 m span, 9 m tall, over the loop
ring pool r 6 m with an inner tile disc at (0, 46)
open lawn 'the Commons' lies north of the district (no buildings; not a district)
three terrace shelves stepping 0.6 m down to the lagoon
promenade path along the front edge
terrace houses (2 rows facing the water)
hover lamps (6 at 50 %)
docked pod at the hub (the warm accent)
extras100: second arch platform on the hub
string of 12 hover lamps along the promenade

accent.object: the first transit pod docked at the hub, apricot nose

districts.name: Canal Quarter
districts.fittedTo: the canal from the front lagoon to its round basin, straddling both banks

anchor.description: the canal · three white glass footbridge arcs

features: canal 7 m wide from the front lagoon to a round basin
3 glass footbridges (arcs, 9 m span) at z = 34, 14 and -6
quay paths on both banks
canal houses in two rows facing the water
market canopies on the west quay (the warm accent)
canal-bridge transit station where the loop crosses
hover lamps along both quays (8 at 50 %)

accent.object: three sail canopies on the west quay

districts.name: Forum Heights
districts.fittedTo: the skyline foot along the back of the land

anchor.description: civic hall lens dome · ring of 8 hover lamps

features: civic hall: low glass lens dome 28 x 18 m, 9 m tall, white shell, cyan strip at the eave, centred at (-30, -60)
forum plaza with a ring of 8 hover lamps (r 17 m) around the hall
forum terminus of the transit loop at (-8, -58)
civic blocks 10 m tall in two rows on the east half of the plaza
two tree rows (12 round canopies) along the forum axis
first row of skyline spires rises directly behind the plaza
blossom pair at the hall entrance (the warm accent)
extras100: council ring (12 seats) on the east lawn
6 flag-less banner masts with cyan strips

accent.object: two blossom trees flanking the hall entrance

districts.name: Skyport Headland
districts.fittedTo: the east headland projecting into the lagoon

anchor.description: airship mooring mast · three H-pad discs

features: mooring mast 18 m at (66, -30), white, beacon at the top (the warm accent)
3 H-pad discs r 5 m with four corner lights at (72, -22), (76, -36), (60, -40)
skyport transit station at (64, -16)
terrace houses on the inland half
hover lamps along the pad apron (6 at 50 %)
glass terraces stepping down to the lagoon on the east tip
extras100: one airship (white hull 16 m, slate gondola) moored at the mast and swaying

districts.name: Arboretum Isle
districts.fittedTo: the lobed solitary island in the front-east lagoon

anchor.description: glass garden dome over a tree canopy

features: garden dome r 9 m, 12 m tall, glass over #8fc48a canopy, centred at (64, 78)
arboretum transit station on the north-west shore at (56, 66)
boardwalk ring path around the dome
greenhouse pods (glass bells) on the east shelf
orchard rows on the south-west shelves (24 round trees at 100 %)
blossom ring around the dome (the warm accent)
extras100: one punt boat at the shelf

accent.object: six blossom trees ringing the dome

plinth.description: Its own headland at the lagoon mouth, south of the skyport, east of the waterfront; glass riser with the cyan strip.

s1.name: Unity Pavilion
s1.description: open ring pavilion: 6 slim white posts, glass lens roof 8 m wide, cyan strip on the roof edge, one blossom tree inside

s2.name: Spire of Accord
s2.description: a white needle rises from the pavilion roof centre, 2 cyan bands, glass lift capsule

s3.name: Spire of Accord, observation lens
s3.description: 36 m spire, 3 cyan bands, a flat glass observation lens deck r 5 m at 28 m, crown that pulses cyan every 4 s at night

ruin.brief: glass frosted #e7f0f2, bands dark, lens deck dark, pavilion strip out; blossom tree bare
ruin.recovery: bands relight bottom to top, frost clears over 2 s, blossom returns

marker.rim: flush glass edge with a 0.3 m cyan light strip, emissive at night

props.description: civic spire: 3 cyan bands; the skyline element and the landmark s3 form
transit arch with a monorail loop segment: one pod on the rail, apricot nose #ff9e6e (the pod is the object carrying the warm note; the saturated accent stays cyan)
garden dome: glass hemisphere over a round canopy
terrace-house pair: PROPOSED change from the draft row's hover lamp (which collides with the lab neon ring at 48 px); windows #ffe9a8 at night. Question 4 in the biome sheet.

marker.silhouette48: a needle spire over a pale mint disc with a cyan rim line

creatureEvent.note: A faint shadow under the clear water most of the time; never within 15 m of a district; never during a catastrophe.

sunShower.rainbow: one flat arc over the lagoon

night.note: the skyline becomes bands of light in fog; no magenta

catastrophe.weather: grey-out: sky drops to #8fa3ad, every strip flickers 3 times and dies, pods coast to a stop
catastrophe.ruin: glass frost: glass frosts to #e7f0f2, strips dark, ring pool drained, 4 hover lamps tilt 20 degrees, canopies drop
catastrophe.recovery: strips relight forum -> skyport -> canal -> waterfront -> island at 0.3 s each, frost clears in 2 s, pods resume
